items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: I was on piano, Edward Johnson on alto sax, Albert Martin on drum, Big Fire on trombone, and Lil Dad on banjo.

ctx.x: With Allen? Yeah. Well they had, I was on piano, Edward Johnson on alto sax, Albert Martin on drum, Big Fire on trombone, and Lil Dad on banjo.
And which Johnson was this on sax? Edward Johnson.
